---
title: Manage Shop
description: Edit individual shop locations or delete outdated outlets from your system.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1375" height="759" style="width: 1375px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Loyalty App > Shop > Shop List.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="271" height="167" style="width: 271px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Click to view  a specific shop details.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="587" height="300" style="width: 587px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Modify shop details and images, delete or duplicate shop.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="416" height="310" style="width: 416px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
